lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is widest at the mid-section (approx. 50-60 pixels) and compresses towards the posterior (approx. 30 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Topological merging observed at the dorsal terminus of the 3rd and 4th lines from the rump; no other distinct bifurcations are visible.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 5 through 8 on the mid-lateral torso are truncated, terminating approximately halfway down the vertical axis of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density cluster comprising 3 distinct white circular spots on the lower posterior haunch, superior to the tarsal joint.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white facial markings (two muzzle spots, thin eye chevron); dark dorsal ridge line; white transverse bands on lower limbs above the hooves.
